summary: Re-ran the two suite failures (Dance circle, Ball play) 4 times each on the live game: all passed when run alone, so they only fail inside the full suite run (order/state dependent flakiness). I did no further exploration and added no tests.

failures.what: Dance circle test fails with 'only 0 dancers' during the full suite run
failures.steps: Run the full live suite; the Dance circle test (minigames.jl) runs after earlier tests. Alone it passes 4/4.
failures.expected: Critters gather in a ring by the lantern and dance
failures.actual: 0 dancers in the suite run (likely state left over from an earlier test, or time of day)

failures.what: Ball play test fails with 'nobody ran after the ball' during the full suite run
failures.steps: Run the full suite; Ball play kicks the ball, Sprout idle 0.41 m from it, Gloop idle at 4.9 m with can-fetch true, rally 0, fetch assigned to Hopscotch at the kick. Alone it passes 4/4.
failures.expected: A critter chases the ball and passes it back
failures.actual: Fetch was assigned to Hopscotch at the kick, but nobody ran after the ball. Possibly the assigned fetcher was far away or busy (the author's LAST_KICK data points at this); it did not show up in isolation.
